text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former ruling National Liberation Front party to hold extraordinary leadership meeting on March 4 to prepare for general elections planned for the first half of 1997.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia holds first talks with Abdelmajid Sidi Said, acting general secretary of workers' main Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA), over a range of social issues.
- The authorities get in an additional 3.3 billion dinars in taxes following a control operation carried out by tax service in central provinces in 1996.
- The Transitional National Council votes party law.
- Algeria forecasts a foreign debt servicing ratio of 31 percent in 1997 and of 38 percent in 1998 and 1999 before a fall to 33 percent in the year 2000.
